rationale: A finite orthogonal eigenbasis gives nonnegative eigenvalues and constructs the root from their unique nonnegative scalar roots. Any competing positive-semidefinite root commutes with the original matrix, preserves its eigenspaces, and must act by the same scalar root on each eigenspace.
